TextInsight is an agentic NLP platform that lets a user upload a CSV, TXT, or PDF file and ask a
natural-language question about it. The system routes the question to the right pretrained NLP tool,
chains multiple tools together when a diagnostic question requires it, and can also give a dataset-aware
model recommendation with evidence clearly separated from external research and system judgment. Nothing
in this codebase performs model training or fine-tuning; every NLP result comes from a pretrained
Hugging Face pipeline run at inference time.
